## What changes for the user?

Describe the failing task and the behavior after this change. Link a related issue when there is one.

## Verification

List commands and manual checks actually completed, with results. For a UI change, include screenshots or a short recording using sample data. Note the macOS version and provider/model where relevant.

## Limits and risks

Mention untested paths, permission or storage changes, and new dependencies or reused code. Preserve license notices and remove private user data from attachments.

- [ ] Checked open PRs for overlapping work.
- [ ] Verified the change, or clearly explained what could not be tested.
- [ ] Updated relevant user-facing docs without marking unreleased work as shipped.
